name: Rozas de Puerto Real (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Rozas de Puerto Real (keys, roundels and a wolf on red).
history: Municipal flag of Rozas de Puerto Real; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Rozas de Puerto Real arms — keys, roundels and wolf on red
